hintsEn.AUS: Under-16 ban in force since 10 December 2025
hintsEn.IDN: Under-16 ban in force since 28 March 2026
hintsEn.MYS: Under-16 ban (platforms with over 8 million users) in force since 1 June 2026
hintsEn.TUR: Under-15 ban in force since 1 November 2026 (existing accounts from March 2027)
hintsEn.BRA: Under-16s need parental consent and linked accounts, in force since 17 March 2026
hintsEn.GBR: Under-16 ban passed June 2026, effective March 2027
hintsEn.GRC: Under-15 ban passed October 2026, effective 1 January 2027
hintsEn.GAB: Under-16s need parental consent, ordinance published April 2026
hintsEn.DNK: Under-15 ban (13–14 with parental consent) agreed by the government in November 2025
hintsEn.PRT: Under-13 ban and parental consent for 13–15 approved by parliament in February 2026, final vote pending
hintsEn.ARE: Under-15 ban announced June 2026, expected by mid-2027
hintsEn.NZL: Under-16 ban announced and bill introduced August 2026
hintsEn.NOR: Minimum age of 15, bill put out for consultation in 2025
hintsEn.CYP: Minimum age of 15 announced by the president in 2026
hintsEn.ESP: Under-16 ban announced by the government in February 2026
hintsEn.CAN: Bill C-34 for an under-16 ban introduced June 2026
hintsEn.PHL: Senate and House passed differing bills in October 2026 (under 18 or 12 and under)
hintsEn.PNG: Users must be 14 or older under an October 2025 policy
hintsEn.BEL: Flemish government considering an under-13 ban
hintsEn.BGR: Party proposal for an under-16 ban
hintsEn.FIN: Prime minister supports an under-15 ban
hintsEn.DEU: Upper house calls for an under-14 ban
hintsEn.POL: Education ministry proposes an under-15 ban
hintsEn.ROU: Parliamentary proposals for limits at 15 or 16
hintsEn.SWE: Government commission suggests 15 (currently parental consent under 13)
hintsEn.CRI: Bill: under-14 ban and parental consent for 14–17
hintsEn.TTO: Prime minister announced an under-12 ban
hintsEn.BHR: Draft law for an under-15 ban
hintsEn.IND: Private bill for an under-16 ban; some states considering
hintsEn.LBN: Draft law for an under-14 ban
hintsEn.PAK: Under-16 bill withdrawn in 2025; 13 or 14 still under consideration
hintsEn.KOR: Seven bills, including an under-14 ban and parental consent under 16
hintsEn.TJK: Lawmaker proposal for an under-14 ban
hintsEn.VNM: Draft: parents register and manage accounts for under-16s
hintsEn.EGY: Parliament intends to legislate; no bill yet
hintsEn.USA: No federal law, several bills; some states in force (Florida bans under-14s)
hintsEn.CHN: No account ban: Minor Mode limits hours and daily time (since 2024)
hintsEn.FRA: Under-15 ban struck down by the Constitutional Council in August 2026
hintsEn.ITA: Prime minister says no ban will be introduced
hintsEn.EST: Justice and digital minister opposes age verification
hintsEn.HRV: Minister rejected a proposal for parental consent under 15
hintsEn.HKG: Government has no plans for a legal ban
hintsEn.JPN: Advisory panel called an Australian-style unified age law undesirable
hintsEn.KEN: Parliament ruled out a TikTok ban in favour of age checks
